_about: The blocking gate's two contract lists (Sprint 20 P3, build/reports/s20-plan.md section 4). 'blocking': every contract check with no break in build/screenshots/sandbox/s19-r2-gate/contract.json (92 checks, which is the 161 of 179 table rows with no break); a break of one of these fails the gate, always. 'advisory': the 18 checks that broke in that run; their breaks are printed, never failing. A check moves between the lists ONLY with a line here naming Zafar's written yes ("Zafar, <date>: <check> to blocking"); no builder or script moves one. A check in both lists or in neither fails gate.test.mjs. A new contract check must be added to one list in the commit that adds it.
